title: Why Propellers Look Bent on Camera 📱

shots.vo: Your phone is lying: this propeller is not bent.
shots.prompt: Medium shot, a man's hand on the left holding a smartphone toward a small single-engine airplane on a sunlit grass airfield on the right; the phone screen clearly shows a propeller with rubbery, bent, curved blades, while the real propeller behind is straight, golden evening light, vertical composition, bright warm light, highly detailed

shots.vo: But here's the catch: your phone never takes a whole picture at once.
